text:
ana: Quick note: Next.js + LangChain starter failing CI intermittently. Onboard flow posts to /api/chain which calls redwoodClient.complete.batch and occasionally returns different counts/ordering when requests retry.
brad: which SDK + sample?\jana: using @redwood/sdk@0.9.0 (node) in samples/next-langchain-starter. LangChain wiring expects stable arrays for scoring.
jing: could be retry dedupe + unordered batch mix. Any logs?
ana: minimal log: request ids [1,2,3] -> responses length 2 and one duplicate id when a retry happened. Fails eval harness seed check.
brad: open an issue in sdk and add a short harness test to assert no duplicates and stable order.
devex-bot: created issue #1102 in sdk repo (labels: sdk,bug,ev-harness)
ana: temp fix: sample maps results by user-provided id then sorts; added note in README and a tiny helper in api/chain.ts.
jing: assign to @brad to prototype SDK change: add stableBatch=true default to JS SDK to match python parity, plus dedupe on id for retry path.
brad: will draft PR and add a microintegration test against the sample.
ana: sample PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/2100 (adds reorder helper and README note).
jing: once SDK change lands we can remove helper; add eval harness test to block regressions.
ana: thanks, I'll post repro steps and a tiny failing fixture in the issue.
